audit.whatIsWrong: Five level-chart rows disagreed with the packet chart, and the full layer disagreed with the content layer's own whys.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Jax / Jax. The content whys already described exactly that arc (whys[0] says do not contest level 1, whys[5] says his first item flips the lane, whys[6] says he wins with 2+ items) while win[] and phases[].side said Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped to Skill, Heimerdinger, Skill, Jax, Jax in both phases[N].side and win[N] as one atomic group, ratings 5/10, 8/10, 5/10, 3/10, 2/10, with the phases whys rewritten to the new owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Heimerdinger spike and the first-item row credited Liandry's, ignoring that Jax's first item is the swing.
audit.why: Grandmaster-at-Arms (110/100/90s) gives armour and magic resist plus third-hit magic damage; Trinity Force / BotRK on-hit lets Leap Strike + Empower out-damage three buildings. Heimerdinger's spikes are levels 4-5 (three banked turret charges plus the flat 11s grenade) and the UPGRADE!!! window, not the item race.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Grandmaster-at-Arms and calls level 6 even; phases[5].why and phases[6].why give the spike to Jax; breakdown.late rewritten to siege-not-side-lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive Counter Strike interaction was only stated in the content layer; the full layer's cooldown, do's and Key Ability Interactions blocks just said 'Dodges turret autos + stuns' with no cooldown and no statement of what it fails to dodge.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming basic attacks only — your autos and the turrets' autofire — then stuns. The grenade's centre stun, Hextech Micro-Rockets and the turret beam are spells and land through it. It is 17/15/13/11/9s against the grenade's flat 11s, so after he burns it you have the window.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state the 17s rank-1 cooldown and that the grenade, rockets and beam are unaffected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told the player Jax's burst opens with an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Empower (W) is an auto reset on a 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown — the visible tell is the weapon wind-up, which happens before the damage, so reacting to the cast is already too late.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1] repurposed to the Empower wind-up tell.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Jax contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Jax has a leash-leap and Counter Strike at level 1 while you have one turret and no stun — do not contest the first contact window.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Counter Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your peak: three banked turret charges and a flat 11s grenade against his 17s Counter Strike, so any leap into the nest is suicidal here.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Jax's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! widens the grenade stun, but Grandmaster-at-Arms answers with resists and third-hit magic damage — level 6 is even.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Counter Strike's cooldown.
edits.after: First items flip it: Trinity Force on-hit lets Leap Strike and Empower out-DPS three buildings in a straight all-in.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Jax carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items and Grandmaster-at-Arms let him tank the whole nest and kill an immobile yordle through it — never duel him.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — build your teamfight around that. Jax carry threat: 10/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Late you lose the 1v1 outright — a super-turret and a wide UPGRADE!!! grenade hold chokes instead. Jax carry threat 10/10: siege with your team, never side lane.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges turret autos + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + turret him.
edits.after: Counter Strike blanks autos and turret fire, never your grenade, rockets or beam — 17s at rank 1, so commit as it ends.

edits.before: Dodges turret autos + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blanks autos and turret fire, then stuns — 17s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges turret autos + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, blanks autos and turret fire only. Bait it, then engage. - Your grenade: flat 11s, so it returns first. - Your ultimate: 100s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empower resets his auto — step back on the wind-up, not the cast.

notes: Name conflict flagged, not acted on. The mirror audit (jax__heimerdinger) renamed Heimerdinger's E from CH-3X to 'CH-2' in its content layer, claiming the full layer used CH-2. This page's full layer contains no CH-2 anywhere — it says 'E-stun' — and the brief's ownerKit carries no ability names, so I could not verify which name Riot currently ships. I left every CH-3X on this page untouched rather than propagate a possibly-retired name. If CH-2 is correct, this page needs a follow-up rename; if CH-3X is correct, jax__heimerdinger needs reverting. Chart rows 0/3/4/5/6 flipped to the packet chart in matched full+content pairs; the existing whys[] already described that arc, so only the side tokens were wrong.
